notes: sig uses DSL type syntax; <T>/<U> are generic parameters. method: true => callable as receiver.name(args) (receiver = first param). property: true => accessed as receiver.name without parentheses (lowered to ["f", name, [receiver]]).
Lambdas passed to map/filter/find/some/every may declare 1 or 2 parameters: (item) or (item, index).
Rounding everywhere = half away from zero. Strings are sequences of Unicode code points (scalars); indices, length, comparison and equality operate on code points, no normalization.

Fixed-point formatting algorithm (used by str() and formatNumber): scaled = x * 10^d computed in double; r = round-half-away-from-zero(scaled) in double; take the exact decimal expansion of r as an integer (Swift: String(format: "%.0f", r); Kotlin: BigDecimal(r).toPlainString()) and insert the decimal point d digits from the right (left-padding with zeros). Never round a decimal string representation: formatNumber(2.675, 2) = '2.67' (2.675*100 = 267.49999999999997), formatNumber(0.125, 2) = '0.13'.

Number to string (str, interpolation, join): integral and |n| < 1e15 => integer digits without fraction ('-0' prints '0'); otherwise fixed with 6 fraction digits (half away from zero) and trailing zeros (and a trailing '.') trimmed. NaN => 'NaN', +/-Infinity => 'Infinity'/'-Infinity'. Decimal separator is always '.'.
str of list/record => compact JSON (records keep insertion order; nested numbers use the rule above); str(null) => 'null'; bool => 'true'/'false'; token values => their JSON encoding.
Arithmetic is IEEE-754 double: x/0 => ±Infinity or NaN, % is fmod (sign of the dividend).
Equality (==) is deep and structural: numbers by value (NaN != NaN), strings by code points, lists elementwise, records by key set + values (order-insensitive), token values by encoding.

Runtime token values: color => {"$color": name} (+"alpha": a when alpha() applied, a multiplies), gradient => {"$gradient": [colors], "angle": deg}, textStyle => {"$type": name}, motion => {"$motion": name} or {"$motion": {spec}}, icon => {"$icon": name}. @space.* and @radius.* evaluate to numbers from the active theme.

round.doc: half away from zero: round(2.5)=3, round(-2.5)=-3

clamp.sig: (x: number, lo: number, hi: number) => number

interpolate.sig: (x: number, input: list<number>, output: list<number>) => number
interpolate.doc: piecewise linear over ascending input stops, clamped to the first/last output outside the range. If lengths differ or fewer than 2 stops: output.first ?? 0.

contains.sig: <T>(x: string | list<T>, v: string | T) => bool
contains.doc: string: substring test; list: deep equality membership

split.doc: keeps empty parts: 'a,,b'.split(',') = ['a','','b']; empty sep => list of single code points

replace.sig: (s: string, a: string, b: string) => string
replace.doc: all literal occurrences; empty a => s unchanged

matches.doc: whole-string match. Use only the common ICU/Java subset: classes [], \d \w \s, quantifiers * + ? {m,n}, groups, alternation, anchors

substring.sig: (s: string, start: number, end?: number) => string
substring.doc: code point indices, clamped to [0, length]; end defaults to length; start >= end => ''

num.doc: trims, parses decimal with optional sign, '.' separator and optional exponent; anything else => null

map.sig: <T, U>(xs: list<T>, f: (T, number) => U) => list<U>

reduce.sig: <T, U>(xs: list<T>, init: U, f: (U, T) => U) => U

set.sig: <T>(xs: list<T>, i: number, v: T) => list<T>

slice.sig: <T>(xs: list<T>, start: number, end?: number) => list<T>

sortBy.doc: stable ascending; numbers numerically, strings by code points

with.doc: copy of record r with fields from patch replaced; patch may only name fields of r with assignable types

formatNumber.doc: fixed `decimals` fraction digits (half away from zero), '.' decimal separator, integer part grouped by 3 with U+00A0 when |x| >= 1000: formatNumber(1990, 0) = '1 990', formatNumber(-1234.5, 1) = '-1 234.5'

formatDuration.doc: negative => 0; whole seconds (floor). hms => 'HH:MM:SS' (hours unbounded, ≥2 digits); ms => 'MM:SS' (minutes unbounded, ≥2 digits); dhms => 'D:HH:MM:SS' (days without padding)

formatDate.doc: epoch ms in env.timeZone: date => 'dd.MM.yyyy', time => 'HH:mm', dateTime => 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm'

plural.sig: (n: number, forms: {one?: string, few?: string, many?: string, other: string}) => string
plural.doc: CLDR category of n for env.locale; 'ru': integer i=|n|: i%10==1 && i%100!=11 => one; i%10 in 2..4 && i%100 not in 12..14 => few; else many; non-integer n => other. 'en','az','ka','uz','ab': n == 1 => one else other. Any other locale => other. Missing form => other. Every '#' in the chosen form is replaced by str(n).

gradient.doc: CSS semantics: 0 = to top, 90 = to right

curve.sig: (duration: number, x1: number, y1: number, x2: number, y2: number) => motion

open.doc: https or a host-allowlisted scheme; anything else is ignored

refresh.doc: argument is a bare data-source name, lowered to ["v", name]

play.doc: bare timeline name; restarts from 0; `await play(x)` resumes when every instance finished (never for repeat -1)

stop.doc: removes the timeline's effect (values return to identity)

callResult: {ok: bool, value: <op result>?, error: {code: string, message: string}?, fieldErrors: map<string>?}
